title: Beverage EDI: Reconcile Pallet Shipments, Advance Ship Notices, and Distributor Receipts
summary: Beverage ASNs built from confirmed pallet contents in NetSuite, checked against the distributor's Orderful guideline, and kept apart from receipts.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Beverage EDI should connect the distributor order to actual pallet and case contents, shipment notices, and later receipts. Preserve product-specific pallet configurations and destination identifiers. Build the outgoing document from warehouse-confirmed contents and validate it against the partner’s requirements before treating technical delivery as complete.


Explore the complete[beverages integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/beverages) for the systems and processes around this guide.
